install_boost_library: clone boost repository, copy mysql library, install dependencies, and bootstrap b2 build system
copy_lib_to_boost: copy a source directory into the boost libs/mysql folder ignoring build artifacts and git
remove_readonly_files: remove read-only files by changing permissions before deletion during tree removal
bootstrap_boost_on_windows: run bootstrap.bat on windows or bootstrap.sh on unix to prepare the boost build system
install_boost_submodules: initialize and update boost git submodules like boostdep, boostbook, docca, and quickbook
